author: Daniel Stukenberg
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pthdnj6

steps.title: Anneal Oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Prepare the annealing reaction in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and cool slowly to room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the reaction in a heatblock for 10 min at 85°C.
Turn off the heatblock and allow samples to remain inside for slow cooling to room temperature.
Proceed to the next step or freeze annealed oligos for long-term storage.
